Office Painting Services in Sydney

Our office painting services in Sydney are designed to upgrade your workspace while keeping your business running smoothly. Whether you manage a small office, a multi-level suite, or an entire commercial building, our team plans each project around your operations, staff, and visitors so you get a fresh, professional look with minimal disruption.

We handle every stage of office painting, from early colour discussions through to the final walkthrough. That includes cleaning and preparing surfaces, repairing minor damage, masking work areas, and applying the right coatings for high-traffic commercial environments. From subtle paintings for office walls that align with your brand to full office building painting for foyers, corridors, and stairwells, we focus on neat lines, even coverage and long-lasting finishes.

props.label: Sec
props.html:
How Much Does Office Painting in Sydney Cost?

The cost of office painting in Sydney depends on several factors. Most businesses look at:

  • Total area to be painted – number of rooms, corridors and common areas
  • Condition of existing surfaces – scuffs, peeling paint, repairs or water damage
  • Type of finishes – standard walls vs feature walls, special coatings or brand colours
  • Access and timing – after-hours work, weekend work, or tight deadlines
  • Interior vs exterior – exterior façades, stairwells and foyers usually require more prep

props.label: Sec
props.html:
Frequently Asked Questions – Office Painting Sydney

What's the difference between office painting and commercial painting in Sydney?

Commercial painting in Sydney covers offices, shops, warehouses, schools and more. Office painting focuses just on workplaces, meeting rooms and shared corporate areas, where appearance, comfort and brand consistency matter most.

What kind of paint do you use?

We use high-quality, durable paints from trusted brands that are suitable for commercial environments.

How much does office painting cost?

The cost depends on the size of your office and the complexity of the job. We offer free quotes!

Will you move my furniture?

We can move furniture or work around it, depending on your preference.

How long does the process take?

Most small offices take a few days. Larger or multi-level spaces can take one to two weeks. Timing depends on prep work, number of coats, access and whether the office is occupied.

Are your painters qualified and insured?

Yes, our team is highly skilled, qualified, and insured for your peace of mind.

/* clone-only: behaviour helpers, no visual or content change */
.mobile-submenu{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0 0 6px;background:#f6f8fc}
.mobile-submenu a{padding-left:40px;font-size:.94rem;font-weight:600}
.mobile-submenu[hidden]{display:none}
header .nav>ul>li:hover>ul{opacity:1!important;visibility:visible!important;transform:translateY(0)!important}

/* clone-only: quote popup */
.spm-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;display:none}
.spm-modal.open{display:block}
.spm-modal__backdrop{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(28,41,63,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);opacity:0;transition:opacity .22s ease}
.spm-modal.open .spm-modal__backdrop{opacity:1}
.spm-modal__scroll{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:24px 16px 40px}
.spm-modal__dialog{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:520px;margin:auto;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.98);opacity:0;transition:transform .24s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1),opacity .24s ease}
.spm-modal.open .spm-modal__dialog{transform:none;opacity:1}
.spm-modal__dialog>div{max-width:none!important;width:100%}
.spm-modal__dialog h2,.spm-modal__dialog h3{padding-right:46px}
.spm-modal__close{position:absolute;top:18px;right:18px;z-index:3;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;border:none;background:var(--light,#f0f0fa);color:var(--navy,#1c293f);font-size:.95rem;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:background .18s ease,color .18s ease,transform .18s ease}
.spm-modal__close:hover{background:var(--primary,#016edc);color:#fff;transform:rotate(90deg)}
.spm-modal__close:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#ffa800);outline-offset:2px}
@media(max-width:520px){.spm-modal__close{top:14px;right:14px;width:32px;height:32px}.spm-modal__dialog h2,.spm-modal__dialog h3{padding-right:40px}}
body.spm-modal-open{overflow:hidden}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.spm-modal__backdrop,.spm-modal__dialog{transition:none}}
